answer: Shard tenancy: joining pins a unique 64 MB retrieval shard, anchored on-ledger, plus a 25-token bond in the vault. Each epoch the committee fires five random byte-range lantern probes; it must return exact bytes with a Merkle proof in 30 seconds, and relays route traffic only for identities holding a valid probe receipt. Two consecutive misses slash half the bond and freeze the ID; re-pinning doubles the bond: 50, then 100. Shards are pubkey-bound, probes independent, so n sybils lock 25n tokens, store 64n MB, and answer n probe streams each epoch: cost linear in n.
